title: Improving Fairness in LLMs Through Testing-Time Adversaries

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring prediction consistency in a criminal recidivism task (COMPAS dataset) when adversarially perturbing the race attribute (African-American vs. Caucasian) in input prompts, and calculating the disparity in performance metrics (such as True Positive Rate, False Positive Rate, Precision, Recall, Accuracy, and Statistical Parity) between the different racial groups.

Evaluating the consistency of the language model's predictions by adversarially perturbing the sex attribute (male vs. female) in the input sentences and observing whether the model's decision changes.
